component.name: DankCalendar
component.summary: Calendar from the Dank Linux Suite

description.p: Dank Calendar is a standalone calendar app for the modern Linux desktop with a Material Design 3 inspired UI. It brings your Local, Google, Microsoft, CalDAV, and iCloud calendars together in one place. It runs as a lightweight daemon with a tray icon, keeps your accounts in sync, and reminds you about events.
It's one of the first to be built with Quickshell, Qt6, and Go. You can optionally pair it with DankMaterialShell (DMS) for a more integrated and streamlined experience.

core: add ability to disable sync per-provider

description.p: Fix credential storage hanging against KeePassXC, remove the login1 permission in favor of suspend-aware timers, and delete single occurrences of recurring events.
Use the XDG notification and secret portals when sandboxed, and align the icon name with the application ID.
Sync calendar colors from more CalDAV and iCal providers.
Navigation improvements, core hours, meeting URL refresh, and embedded UI packaging.
